scope: Ordinary editable buffers; prompts and special buffers retain editor-native behavior.

invariants.typing: Completed actions return to insertion, except explicit selection and visible prompts. Typing replaces a selection.
invariants.selection: Selection has a persistent anchor; releasing the firmware layer does not cancel it. Cancel collapses selection.
invariants.movement: Reference positions are UTF-8 codepoint insertion boundaries, not grapheme or Normal-mode character positions. Vertical movement follows logical lines. Adapter deviations must be declared.
invariants.deletion: Delete the half-open range from the insertion position to the requested target, preserving registers.
invariants.undo: Each completed destructive action is a separate undo unit.
invariants.failure: Missing targets do not change text; unsupported actions must be identified in the capability matrix.
invariants.transport: Modifiers and function keys must arrive distinctly; transport is unverified until tested on the actual host.
